name: The Parrot
effect: Most of the time it just repeats the user's prompt back word for word ("What is the meaning of life?") and gives no answer. Once in a while it rephrases it slightly ("Here are three tips for a job interview.") or gets stuck in a repetition
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
